title: Tough Assembly...But We Like It
text: Tough Assembly...But We Like It. It appears they have changed their hardware to attach the sides to the bottom several times in the last few years.  From allen screw with allen wrench to small bolt that needed a nut and now you get larger bolts that are too big for the drilled holes.  Luckily we had a tap set and were able to make the holes bigger.  Otherwise we would have needed to buy smaller bolts and probably nuts.  Now that it's assembled we are happy with it's construction and looks.  The log tote looks as if it will stand up to many trips to the wood pile.  Overall we are happy with our purchase.
